request: Create an approved, reusable podcast player block for Made With These Hands. Use Media Chrome as the recommended open-source audio-control foundation where a shadcn primitive does not cover native podcast playback. The block should connect Hugh McNeill podcast episodes to maker pages, related products, transcripts, and external listening links while remaining editable through Directus MCP.
requested_by: Codex / Made With These Hands demo branch

proposal.label: Podcast Player
proposal.description: A branded, accessible episode player for Hugh McNeill podcast audio, related maker context, external listen links, transcript prompts, and connected object shelves.

trustedOpenSource.purpose: Accessible, brandable native media controls for audio and video playback.

fields.name: episode
fields.note: Episode slug, number, or Directus relation key.

fields.name: audio_url
fields.note: Direct audio URL from Podbean/RSS or uploaded Directus file URL. No embed JavaScript.

accessibility: Use native audio semantics and labelled controls.
All play, pause, seek, mute, and transcript controls must be keyboard operable.
Visible focus states are required for every control.
Provide a text transcript or transcript link where available.
External listen links must be plain anchors with readable labels.
proposal.bespoke_gap: shadcn provides buttons, cards, and layout primitives, but it does not provide accessible native audio playback controls, seek/progress controls, or media controller semantics. Media Chrome is the trusted MIT-licensed open-source media-control package for this gap; CMS content stores only data such as audio URLs, episode metadata, transcript text, and related content slugs.

checks.reason: Slots are inside the tenant page-slot contract.
Podcast/audio playback uses the trusted Media Chrome package rather than arbitrary embeds.

trusted_packages.purpose: Accessible, brandable native media controls for audio and video playback.
